# Block `exercises`

**Use:** An exercise sheet from the material: several exercises, each with checked tasks and model solutions.

**Avoid:** One or two questions — use practice.

## Example

```json
{
  "kind": "exercises",
  "sheet": {
    "id": "sheet-1",
    "title": "Exercise sheet 1",
    "description": "Indexes and selectivity.",
    "source": "Tutorial 1",
    "exercises": [
      {
        "id": "ex-1",
        "title": "Selectivity",
        "tasks": [
          {
            "id": "ex-1-a",
            "prompt": "A query returns 50 of 1,000 rows. What is its selectivity?",
            "check": {
              "mode": "text",
              "accept": [
                "0.05",
                "5%"
              ]
            },
            "solution": "50 / 1000 = 0.05."
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  },
  "source": [
    {
      "file": "slides.pdf",
      "page": 4
    }
  ]
}
```

| Field | Type | Required |

| `sheet.exercises[].title` | string | yes |

| `sheet.exercises[].tasks` | array of object | yes |
